added_examples.translation: <...> Das Brennholz lag oben auf dem Ofen. Er zerkleinerte es, tat es in den Backofen, ging und blies in das Feuerloch, um den Ofen für die Frau zum brennen zu bringen.

summary: Provisional new root bṣṣ is supported by one surface mbaṣaṣle. The II pattern is compatible with this reading; only its Preterit base is entered, and the Infectum slot is explicitly unattested.

The firewood is named before the verb and subsequently put into the oven. This supports material reduction/fragmentation, but not specifically chopping with a tool versus breaking by hand; the gloss stays at zerkleinern.

Read-only lookup confirms no bṣṣ entry. bṣbṣ concerns sparkling and has different reduplicated consonants; bṣṭ concerns dough shaping, beating and ordering, with a final ṭ. Neither licenses silent emendation of mbaṣaṣle.
